name: What types of flooring are best for water damage resistance?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring are best for water damage resistance?

acceptedAnswer.text: For areas prone to moisture or where water damage is a concern, materials like luxury vinyl plank (LVP), ceramic or porcelain tile, and certain types of engineered hardwood with water-resistant cores are excellent choices. LVP and tile are highly water-resistant and durable. While no flooring is completely waterproof, these options offer superior protection compared to traditional solid hardwood or laminate, reducing the risk of extensive damage in future incidents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury vinyl plank (LVP), ceramic/porcelain tile, and some water-resistant engineered hardwoods are best for water damage resistance. These materials offer superior protection compared to traditional options.
